It was jointly composed by Fred and bandmate Andrew Bernard.

Billboard magazine noted that it was recorded not in New York, Los Angeles, or Nashville, but "in a small studio in Tyler, Texas." (Robin Hood Studios, which is still going and is credited with some other notable historic recordings) Arrangements and content The song features strings, brass, a sitar, piano, bass, guitar, drums, breathing sounds, and dissonant string sounds.
